target.title: fix(agents): emit model.failover diagnostic on normal model fallback transitions
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Model fallback chains in production are invisible in OTel/Prometheus traces — `model.failover` diagnostic events are only emitted from the cooldown lane-suspension branch, so ordinary model-to-model fallback transitions never reach the diagnostics pipeline.

- **Problem**: When a session retries with a different model, operators cannot observe the fallback chain because `emitFailoverEvent` is only called on cooldown lane suspension, not on normal candidate failure → next candidate transitions
- **Solution**: Restructure `observeFailedCandidate` to emit a `model.failover` diagnostic event for every run failure, independent of trajectory/logging configuration
- **What changed**: `src/agents/model-fallback.ts` — the `observeFailedCandidate` function now calls `emitFailoverEvent` with from/to provider/model, reason, cascade depth, and `suspended=false` after candidate failures, guarded on `nextCandidate` to avoid false telemetry from single-model runs or exhausted chains
- **What did NOT change**: The existing `DiagnosticFailoverEvent` type, OTel exporter, Prometheus exporter, suspension-path emission, fallback selection logic, or retry/backoff/circuit-breaker policy

## Change Type (select all)

- [x] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Refactor required for the fix
- [ ] Docs
- [ ] Security hardening
- [ ] Chore/infra

## Scope (select all)

- [x] Gateway / orchestration
- [ ] Skills / tool execution
- [ ] Auth / tokens
- [ ] Memory / storage
- [ ] Integrations
- [x] API / contracts
- [ ] UI / DX
- [ ] CI/CD / infra

## Linked Issue/PR

- Related to #102015
- [x] This PR fixes a bug or regression

## Motivation

The existing `DiagnosticFailoverEvent` infrastructure (event type, emitter, OTel span/metric handler, Prometheus counter) was already fully implemented and tested, but only wired into the cooldown lane-suspension path. Normal fallback transitions (candidate A fails → candidate B attempted) only reached the trajectory recorder (`onFallbackStep` / `model.fallback_step`), making retry storms invisible in monitoring.

This is a narrow plumbing fix — connect the existing event type to the existing emission point in normal fallback paths.

## Evidence

- **Behavior addressed**: `model.failover` diagnostic event is now emitted when a model candidate fails and the fallback loop proceeds to the next candidate
- **Real environment tested**: Linux x86_64, Node 22.19.0, branch `fix/emit-failover-diagnostic-102015`
- **Exact steps or command run after this patch**:

```
# Step 1: Copy proof script from evidence dir to project root
cp /media/vdb/code/github/contributions/pr-102015-evidence/run-proof.mts run-proof.mts

# Step 2: Run E2E proof script (calls runWithModelFallback + captures events)
node --import tsx run-proof.mts

# Step 3: Clean up temp file
rm run-proof.mts

# Step 4: Run existing test suites for regression
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/model-fallback.test.ts --run
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/diagnostics-otel/src/service.test.ts --run
```

- **Evidence after fix**:

```console
$ node --import tsx run-proof.mts

=== model.failover event payload ===
{
  "type": "model.failover",
  "sessionId": "session:proof-live",
  "lane": "main",
  "fromProvider": "openai",
  "fromModel": "gpt-5.5",
  "toProvider": "anthropic",
  "toModel": "claude-opus-4-6",
  "reason": "rate_limit",
  "cascadeDepth": 0,
  "suspended": false,
  "seq": 2,
  "ts": 1783493821308
}

Result: ✅ fallback returned ok
Emitted: ✅ 1 model.failover event
Fields: ✅ all contract fields correct
Overall: ✅ PASS
```

The diagnostic event payload was captured via `onTrustedInternalDiagnosticEvent` subscription to the real diagnostic event bus. The `runWithModelFallback` function (patched code on this branch) emitted the `model.failover` event with correct `fromProvider`/`fromModel`, `toProvider`/`toModel`, `reason` (`rate_limit`), `cascadeDepth` (0 = first fallback step), and `suspended: false`.

- **Observed result after fix**:
  - `model.failover` diagnostic event flows through `emitFailoverEvent()` with full payload (proven by subscription to `onTrustedInternalDiagnosticEvent`)
  - Guard on `nextCandidate` prevents false events for single-model runs (verified: 0 events)
  - Guard on `nextCandidate` prevents false events for terminal exhausted candidate (verified: only 1 event for the real transition, not for the last failure)
  - All existing 115 model-fallback tests pass (no regression)
  - All existing 107 diagnostics-otel tests pass (exporter contract preserved)
- **What was not tested**: Full gateway E2E with real OTel collector endpoint (requires separate OTLP collector); the code change is purely additive (calls existing `emitFailoverEvent`) and the OTel exporter is tested independently

## Root Cause

`emitFailoverEvent` was introduced in `d5eec80e340` (2026-05-15) for the cooldown lane-suspension branch only. Normal fallback transitions (candidate failed → try next) only called `onFallbackStep` for trajectory recording and never emitted the diagnostic event. Carried forward by `9fd9aa5fcdd2` which refactored suspension logic but preserved the gap.

## Regression Test Plan

- `pnpm test src/agents/model-fallback.test.ts` — covers existing fallback behavior
- `pnpm test extensions/diagnostics-otel/src/service.test.ts` — covers OTel exporter handling of `model.failover`

## User-visible / Behavior Changes

Operators using OTel/Prometheus tracing will now see `model.failover` events for normal fallback transitions, with `openclaw.failover.*` span attributes and `openclaw.model.failover` counter metrics. No user-facing behavior changes.

## Best-fix Verdict

- **Best fix**: Yes — the fix is the minimal plumbing change: call the existing `emitFailoverEvent` at the right code point, guarded on `nextCandidate` to avoid false telemetry. Alternative (adding events at each call site of `observeFailedCandidate`) would be fragile and miss future code paths.
- **Refactor needed**: No
- **Alternative considered**: Add `emitFailoverEvent` before each `observeFailedCandidate` call site (like PR #102046). Rejected because it would not cover `LiveSessionModelSwitchError` path.

## Security Impact

- [x] New permissions/capabilities? No
- [x] Secrets/tokens handling changed? No
- [x] New/changed network calls? No
- [x] Command/tool execution surface changed? No
- [x] Data access scope changed? No

## Compatibility / Migration

- [x] Backward compatible? Yes
- [x] Config/env changes? No
- [x] Migration needed? No

## Human Verification

- **Verified scenarios**: All existing test suites pass; focused proof test confirms diagnostic event payload with correct fields
- **Edge cases checked**: Multiple fallback depths, `LiveSessionModelSwitchError` path, cooldown suspension path (pre-existing emission preserved), single-model run (no event), exhausted chain last candidate (no event from normal path)
- **What you did NOT verify**: Live fallback with real provider (requires API keys)

## AI Assistance

- **AI-assisted**: Yes
- **Co-Authored-By**: `Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>`
- **Human confirmed understanding of code changes**: Yes
- **AI prompts / session excerpts**: Fix rationale described in issue #102015 analysis; code change scoped to single function per ClawSweeper narrow-fix guidance. Full transcription available in session logs.

## Risks and Mitigations

- **Highest risk**: Diagnostic event emission is purely additive — no behavior change for non-telemetry users. The `emitFailoverEvent` is already wired into the OTel/Prometheus exporters.
- **Mitigation**: All existing tests pass; no new code paths, only reuse of existing trusted function.
- **Compatibility**: Fully backward compatible.

---
